frames.heading: Goliath
frames.body: The resonance of your music speaks to our very souls. We Goliaths have longed for the return of the rock spirit, and now, we shall aid you in your quest.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Thanks Goliaths, we're honoured to have your strength and rhythm with us!

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Together, we'll make the caverns quake with the power of our rock!

frames.heading: Goliath
frames.body: Then let us descend into the depths of these caverns, where the heartbeat of Ampiforia lies dormant. Our feet shall echo the rhythm of our music, and together, we shall awaken the Thunderstone!

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: It's getting darker. But our music will light the way!

frames.heading: Gnork
frames.body: That's the spirit! Let our melodies pierce through the shadows and guide us to our destination!

frames.heading: Goliath
frames.body: Behold, travellers! Before us lies the barrier that guards the path to the Thunderstone. Let our music be the hammer that shatters it!

frames.heading: Gnork
frames.body: On my count, let the music flow like a mighty river, breaking down all obstacles in its path! One, two, three... ROCK!!!
